_capsolver_key_note: get one at capsolver.com, only needed for capsolver labelers
_proxies_note: Proxy list rotated round-robin across threads, format http://user:pass@host:port, empty string means direct connection.
_target_note: stop collecting a (grid,class) once it has this many positive tiles
_max_note: 0 = run until every class hits target (or Ctrl-C)
_neg_note: if false, only positive tiles are saved
_labeler_note: model = local ONNX classifier (free), capsolver = paid ground-truth
